name: Late Jaswantsinhji Thakor and Late Rasiklal Andhariya Classical Music Scholarship
benefit: > **For Gurus:** - Financial assistance of ₹1,000/- per month for a duration of 10 months (i.e., ₹10,000/- per disciple) for training up to 2 disciples. > **For Disciples:** - A scholarship of ₹10,000/- per annum, calculated at ₹1,000/- per month for 10 months, for receiving classical music training from the selected Guru.
_eligibility_text: > **For Gurus:** - The applicant should be a classical music artist. - The applicant should have completed formal education in classical music or must possess at least 7 years of experience in teaching classical music. - The applicant should be capable of training a maximum of 2 disciples during the 10-month training period. > **For Disciples:** - The applicant should be a student of classical music residing in Gujarat. - The applicant should be undergoing training under an eligible Guru selected under this scheme. - The applicant should submit a certificate of training provided by the Guru.
